company.shortDescription: Firezone is an open-source security platform to manage secure remote access for teams.

productsAndServices.description: An open-source platform for managing secure remote access using WireGuard-based VPN technology with granular, least-privileged access controls.
productsAndServices.name: Firezone Platform

productsAndServices.description: Native client applications for Windows, macOS, Linux, iOS, and Android that connect users securely to Firezone-managed resources.
productsAndServices.name: Firezone Client Applications

productsAndServices.description: A lightweight Linux binary deployed on servers that routes and enforces secure access to protected resources through WireGuard tunnels.
productsAndServices.name: Firezone Gateway

productsAndServices.description: A system that enforces granular, group-based access policies controlling user permissions to resources and network traffic.
productsAndServices.name: Access Management and Policy Engine

productsAndServices.description: Integration features that sync users and groups from identity providers and support authentication via email OTP or OpenID Connect.
productsAndServices.name: Directory Synchronization and Authentication Integration
